newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Bau Holding sees uptick in earnings.
newsitem.headline: Bau Holding sees uptick in earnings.

text.p: Austrian construction group Bau Holding said on Thursday it expected pre-tax profits to rise to around 250 million schillings in the year to March 31, from 224.4 million in the previous financial year.

"We will be able to manage a result of around 250 million schillings", Bau Holding's chief financial officer Hannes Truntschnig told an investors' conference, adding that the backlog of orders on hand remained at a high level.

By the end of November, orders worth about 10.8 billion schillings had been in the books, Truntschnig said. He added several newer projects, including an 1.3 billion schilling order to build a new hotel in Prague, were not yet reflected in that figure.
Bau Holding reported six-month sales of 10.05 (8.8) billion schillings and a net profit of 136 (105) million schillings in November. -- Christian Gutlederer, Vienna newsroom +43 1 53112-275
